name: OfficeCLI Data Dashboard
summary: Multi-element Excel dashboards from CSV or tabular input: Dashboard sheet on open, formula-driven KPI cards, charts, sparklines and conditional formatting. OpenAR-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill, published in lockstep with the compiled curated body at the same version (same version, same bytes): the upstream install commands and the manual-releases fallback are replaced with the pinned, checksum-verified host install path (an ora cli-adapter changeset the user approves and stages), the verify sentence points at list-adapters/run-cli-adapter, and an Apache-2.0 4(b) provenance notice is appended; everything else is upstream text.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 从 CSV 或表格输入生成多元素 Excel 仪表盘：打开即 Dashboard 表、公式驱动 KPI 卡、图表、迷你图与条件格式。 iOfficeAI/AionCore 技能的 OpenAR 适配携带，与同版本编译 curated 正文锁步发布（同版本=同字节）：上游安装命令与 GitHub releases 手动回退替换为钉版校验的宿主安装路径（经用户批准并 stage 的 ora cli-adapter 变更集），验证句改为 list-adapters/run-cli-adapter 指引，并追加 Apache-2.0 4(b) 修改声明；其余为上游原文。
